planet.name: ARIS
planet.summary: ARIS is a robot-occupied moon next to Calypso, opened on 7 May 2025 (VU 18.14.0) and run by the Planet Partner Hyperion Enterprises. The home base is Ironhaven. The main loop is earning Hyperion Daily Vouchers from weekly contracts, sample runs, 20-hour boss instances and one-time missions, then spending them on Hyperion armor and blueprints. There are no flying vehicles and no Mindforce teleport chips, so you travel on foot, by ground vehicle and by the teleporters you have registered. A southern continent with the outpost Breakwater was added on 11 Nov 2026 (VU 19.12.0).
planet.howToReach: With your own spacecraft and a Space Thruster: launch from Calypso, fly to the ARIS space station (it is close to Calypso), land in the hangar, then use the station teleporter and pick 'ARIS Space Station Transit'. You can also get a lift from another player's ship. Teleporting straight between planets has existed since June 2025. You use the planet's main landing teleporter, and it costs 10 Teleportation Tokens since VU 19.2.0 (Dec 2025). To leave, use the ARIS Space Station Transit teleporter.
warnings: No flying vehicles anywhere on ARIS and Mindforce teleportation is fully blocked. Plan routes by teleporter and ground vehicle. Most ocean and pond water is caustic to avatars, though since VU 19.3.0 (Jan 2026) boats and ships are safe on the ocean around ARIS.

The economy changed on 11 Nov 2026 (VU 19.12.0): some hunting dailies became weekly contracts, and the sample mission is weekly. Rewards were re-tuned in VU 19.12.1 on 17 Nov 2026. Voucher numbers here are a mix of tracker data and player reports from 12-18 Nov 2026 and may move again.

Many monsters are high level. The developers admitted at launch that the entry level was too high, then added Weak, Faint and Defective creatures around Ironhaven (VU 18.15.0). New players should stay near Ironhaven at first.

Waypoint strings are copied exactly from their sources. Entropia Hub labels the planet 'Planet ARIS', Ripcraze uses 'Aris', and in-game copies posted on the forum use 'ARIS'. If a paste does not work in game, change the first field to ARIS.

Sound bugs on ARIS were a known issue from launch through 2025. VU 19.12.0 fixed a sound-memory problem that hit ARIS especially. Some players also report low frame rates inside the main Ironhaven building and in the new dock areas (Nov 2026).
Prices and markup quoted here come from players in trade chat or on the forum. Markup changes all the time. Nothing here is a profit promise.

activities.title: First trip: fly from Calypso to the ARIS space station
activities.summary: On your first visit, fly a spacecraft (yours or a friend's) from Calypso to the ARIS space station, then teleport down. The flight is short because ARIS orbits close to Calypso.
steps: On Calypso, equip a Space Thruster and launch to space with a spaceworthy craft (or ask in chat for a lift; players often offer rides or warps).
Fly toward ARIS, which shows on the space map. Aim for the space station rather than the planet itself.
Land inside the station hangar, walk to the teleporter, choose ARIS in the list and pick 'ARIS Space Station Transit'.
You arrive in a surface hangar next to Ironhaven. Continue with the Ironhaven orientation.
rewards: Registers the ARIS Space Station Transit teleporter
requirementsText: Spacecraft plus Space Thruster, or a ride on another player's ship
Planet download in the client loader (one player had to restart the client before ARIS appeared)

cost.text: Craft fuel plus thruster decay. One newcomer guide (Aug 2025) says a thruster decays about 0.10 PED per launch and per landing and costs about 7 PED, and says docking at the station avoids the landing decay. Rides from players may be free or paid.
cost.markupNote: Thrusters and small craft trade near TT plus a modest markup per that video; check current auction.

locations.label: ARIS in space (player-posted in-game waypoint, May 2025)
ARIS Space Station Transit (surface arrival teleporter)

score.rationale: Required to start anything on ARIS. Cheap if you already own a craft or get a ride.

warnings: The two space coordinates differ slightly. Both point at ARIS; fly toward the visible station.
The thruster decay numbers come from one player's video, not from MindArk.

activities.title: Planet-to-planet teleport with Teleportation Tokens
activities.summary: ARIS is on the official list of planets you can teleport between directly from the main landing teleporter, without flying. Since VU 19.2.0 it costs 10 Teleportation Tokens per jump. Use it to return to Calypso or to come back to ARIS later.
steps: Get Teleportation Tokens. They are crafted from a blueprint sold at Space Mining Terminals, or bought from players.
Go to the main landing teleporter (the ARIS Space Station Transit on ARIS; Port Atlantis Mall is the example MindArk gives for Calypso).
Pick the destination planet. The jump costs 10 tokens.
rewards: Fast travel between ARIS, Calypso and the other listed destinations
requirementsText: 10 Teleportation Tokens per jump (since VU 19.2.0)
150 kg teleport weight limit was set when interplanetary teleport launched (VU 18.9.0)

cost.text: 10 Teleportation Tokens per jump. Their PED value was not found in any source.
cost.markupNote: Token price depends on crafting cost and the player market.

activities.limits: Must leave from the planet's main landing teleporter.

score.rationale: Saves a flight each session. Token cost is unknown, so the budget score is middling.

warnings: Players in May 2025 and a March 2026 video describe the teleport from ARIS back to Calypso as free. VU 19.11.0 (Oct 2026) fixed 'certain interplanetary teleports' that did not consume tokens, so assume it now costs 10 tokens.
The official notes do not say whether you must visit ARIS by ship once before you can teleport there.

activities.title: Ironhaven orientation: meet the mission givers
activities.summary: Walk from the transit hangar into Ironhaven HQ. Register the Ironhaven teleporters and talk to every NPC to pick up the starter and repeatable missions. This is where all the voucher activities start.
steps: From the transit hangar, walk up to the HQ and register the Ironhaven Entrance and Ironhaven teleporters (the internal 'tube system').
Talk to the Ironhaven representative first, then General Tiberius Ashfall for the main one-time missions.
Find Jimothy (hunting contracts), Tonathan (AI missions), Dr. Cassian Hart (samples) and McGrangus (mining and construction).
Look at the Hyperion voucher exchange terminal and the armor upgrade station so you know your long-term goal.
If you hear no sound, turn sound off and on again in Options (a launch-era bug).
requirementsText: Be on ARIS (by ship or by token teleport; see the two travel entries)

cost.text: Free.

locations.label: Daily/weekly hunting mission NPCs inside HQ (player-posted)

score.rationale: Free, fast, and it unlocks everything else on ARIS.

warnings: NPC names come from player videos from 2025-2026. VU 19.10.3 moved Bonnie Garland and Fenton Bunting outside the main building.

activities.title: Register the Transit Base teleporters
activities.summary: Mindforce teleport chips and flying vehicles do not work on ARIS, so registered teleporters are your only fast travel. There are nine Transit Bases (Alfonso through Isaac) plus the Ironhaven ones. Start with the ones close to Ironhaven and add the rest as your gear improves.
steps: Bring a ground vehicle (and repair kit) and spare healing.
Start with Alfonso and Delphine, the closest to Ironhaven, then Cassius.
Add Bianca, Edwin, Freya, Gannon, Hedwig and Isaac later. They sit near dangerous spawns, so skirt around aggressive creatures.
Each teleporter registers when you reach it.
rewards: Much cheaper access to instances, samples and scientists
requirementsText: Ground vehicle strongly recommended

cost.text: Vehicle oil and repairs, plus healing if you are attacked.

score.rationale: Teleporters are the backbone of travel on ARIS, and every other activity gets cheaper once you have them.

warnings: Entropia Hub and Entropia Nexus coordinates agree within about 10 m. Entropia Hub's waypoints use the label 'Planet ARIS'.
VU 18.15.0 added an outpost teleporter on the south tip of Ironhaven island. No source names it, so it is not listed here.

activities.title: ARIS Samples (Dr. Cassian Hart)
activities.summary: The easiest voucher source: visit marked sample sites and click them. There is no kill requirement. Newcomer videos call it the best first mission. It now runs on a weekly timer and pays 2 Hyperion Daily Vouchers.
steps: Take the sample mission from Dr. Cassian Hart in Ironhaven.
Check which site you got. Videos name Crater Rim (doable), Furor Lab (hard aggro) and three Spina areas, with Spina 3 the hardest. Since VU 19.12.0 sites can also be in the south.
Drive to each marker, avoid aggressive creatures, and interact with the sample points.
Return to Dr. Cassian Hart for the reward.
rewards: 2 Hyperion Daily Vouchers (tracker and a player report, Nov 2026)
requirementsText: Ground vehicle recommended
Some sites sit in high-level spawns

cost.text: Only vehicle oil and repairs. Dying costs armor decay and time.

activities.limits: One active sample mission at a time.

cooldown.resetNote: Ripcraze lists a 168 h (weekly) cooldown, and a player confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that it is still weekly. Sources do not say whether the timer starts when you accept or when you complete.

score.rationale: Free vouchers for a short drive, but only once a week now.

warnings: This was a daily ('Daily Samples') in 2025 and early 2026. The weekly timer comes from a community tracker and player reports, not from the official notes.
One player reported the mission giver still showing a quest marker a week after abandoning it (18 Nov 2026).

activities.title: Hyperion Hunting Contract (Jimothy, weekly)
activities.summary: Jimothy's three hunting dailies were replaced on 11 Nov 2026 by a weekly contract. You choose low, medium or high difficulty and get a random target. Ripcraze lists 4, 8 or 12 vouchers by difficulty. The low tier is meant to be doable with starter-pack gear.
steps: Abandon any old Jimothy hunting dailies you still hold, including stage 2 and 3. The weekly will not be offered until all of them are gone.
Talk to Jimothy and pick a difficulty. Low suits newcomers.
Hunt the assigned target. The progress bar fills by damage/decay spent, so a fast-killing weapon beats an efficient one here.
Hand in to Jimothy.
rewards: 4 / 8 / 12 Hyperion Daily Vouchers for low / medium / high (Ripcraze; re-tuned in VU 19.12.1)
requirementsText: Low tier: starter-level weapon (Frontier-class) per a March 2026 video of the old tier 1

cost.text: Ammo, decay and healing. A player reported about 750 PED cycled for the top tier before the 17 Nov fix. The old tier-1 daily cost about 10-15 PED (Aug 2025 video).
cost.markupNote: Costs are mostly TT spend that comes back partly as loot.

cooldown.resetNote: Weekly (168 h) per Ripcraze and the 19.12.0 notes. Start point (accept or completion) not confirmed.

score.rationale: Main steady voucher source. The low tier is cheap and beginner-friendly.

warnings: Official (VU 19.12.0, 11 Nov 2026): selected hunting dailies were replaced by weekly missions. Dailies you had already accepted can still be finished, but they are no longer handed out, so you cannot take them again. A player found the weekly was only offered after abandoning every old daily.

Players said the first weekly paid fewer vouchers than the old dailies (about 12 versus 21 a week). The developer agreed, and VU 19.12.1 (17 Nov 2026) fixed the contribution values and rewards of the two new weekly hunting quests. Check the in-game reward.
Before 19.12.0 this was three daily missions (stages 1-3) worth 1 voucher each. Older guides describe that version.

activities.title: Daily Mining (McGrangus)
activities.summary: McGrangus hands out a daily mining mission worth 1 voucher. The ARIS ore spawns and these missions were rebuilt in VU 19.2.0 and now centre on ARIS-specific ores.
steps: Take the mining mission from McGrangus in Ironhaven.
Drop probes in the area for the requested ARIS ore.
Hand in the ore or result for the voucher.
requirementsText: Finder, excavator and probes

cost.text: Probes and tool decay. Mining returns vary.
cost.markupNote: ARIS ingots are used in Hyperion weapon crafting; a June 2026 player list shows them at various markups.

score.rationale: A cheap extra voucher for miners. Probe cost makes it less free than samples.

warnings: Mining is blocked in the Bovine caves (VU 19.2.0).

activities.title: Unlock component blueprints with vouchers
activities.summary: The voucher vendor sells seven component blueprints for 30 vouchers plus 2 PED each: Enhanced Filter, Durable Weapon Sight, Durable Laser Optics, Reinforced Buffers, Reinforced Casing, CushionCore Padding and FlexPlate Fabric. You need them for the daily crafting mission and for Hyperion armor materials.
steps: Collect 30 vouchers.
At the voucher terminal in Ironhaven, buy the blueprint you need (30 vouchers + 2 PED).
Craft the component from robot parts and common materials.
rewards: Lets you do the crafting daily
requirementsText: 30 Hyperion Daily Vouchers + 2 PED per blueprint

cost.text: 2 PED plus 30 vouchers per blueprint.
cost.markupNote: A 2025 video saw a Reinforced Casing blueprint listed for about 169 PED and suggested pulling blueprints to order for other players. Prices change.

cooldown.resetNote: One purchase per blueprint you want.

score.rationale: Needed for crafting dailies and armor materials, but it uses vouchers that could go toward armor.

warnings: The cost table is from May 2025 and was not re-confirmed after VU 19.12.0.

activities.title: Daily Crafting / Construction (McGrangus)
activities.summary: McGrangus also gives a daily construction mission worth 1 voucher. A 2025 guide says it asks for 25 attempts (they don't need to succeed) with one of the voucher blueprints, and the requested item changes daily.
steps: Own the component blueprint the mission asks for.
Take the mission from McGrangus.
Craft 25 attempts.
Hand in.
requirementsText: The right blueprint (each costs 30 vouchers)
Materials for 25 attempts

cost.text: Materials for 25 crafting attempts.
cost.markupNote: Components may sell above TT, but that is not guaranteed.

activities.limits: Without all blueprints, some days' requests will be impossible.

score.rationale: Steady for crafters, but needs blueprint investment first.

activities.title: Low-level hunting near Ironhaven
activities.summary: After the launch feedback, Ironhaven island got lower levels of Weak, Defective and Faint creatures, and VU 18.14.1 rebalanced the trade-terminal weapons for this level. Weak Mortirex sit right next to Ironhaven. The mushroom area ('Taste the Mushroom') gives Regular Bovines in three maturity brackets.
steps: Start on Weak Mortirex and Weak Verderon spawns just east of Ironhaven, then Faint Fieroids and Defective Drones.
For Bovines, take the 'Taste the Mushroom' entrance. Since VU 19.12.0 there are three entrances for three maturity brackets.
Avoid Derelict robots early. Gen 1 Destroyers are reported at about 1,300 HP.
rewards: Skills, loot and Codex progress at low cost
requirementsText: Starter-pack-level weapon and armor

cost.text: Ammo and decay. You choose the pace.

locations.label: Taste the Mushroom (teleport to Regular Bovines)
Weak Mortirex (Meekling) spawn, about 38722, 22378 per Entropia Nexus

score.rationale: Safe filler that also feeds the weekly contract and Codex.

warnings: Spawn data comes from Entropia Nexus map areas and may lag behind game changes.

activities.title: Find the dead scientists (north)
activities.summary: A one-time exploration mission: find and touch ten dead scientists around the northern map. There is no combat requirement, and players list the reward as 10 Hyperion Daily Vouchers. A newcomer guide recommends it as an early goal.
steps: Pick up the mission (it appears when you find the first scientist).
Visit each scientist and interact. Gregor is inside the mountain below the mushroom entrance, Marie is below a waterfall and Ynes is at the bottom of a pit.
One area sits behind a door needing a code. Entropia Hub lists an 'Input Password' point with code 53180088008135.
Finish all ten to complete.
requirementsText: Ground vehicle; careful routing around high-level spawns

cost.text: Travel only, plus deaths if you pull creatures.

locations.label: Dead Scientist Gregor (inside mountain below the mushroom entrance)

score.rationale: Ten free vouchers and a tour of the map. Takes a while on foot.

warnings: The 10-voucher reward comes from players in June 2025, not official notes.

activities.title: Auxilium Plant: Droktimus Prime (easiest robot instance)
activities.summary: The entry-level daily robot instance. Clear small robots and turrets, use the side computers to open the doors, then kill the level-15 boss Droktimus Prime. Videos say a strong starter weapon can do it with healing. The boss can drop blueprints, Hyperium, armor catalysts and, rarely, valuable unlimited weapons.
steps: Drive to the Auxilium Plant entrance at the top of the map.
Inside, kill the robots and click the computers in the side rooms to unlock the gate.
Kill the turrets from range, then the boss.
Loot and leave. Leaving voluntarily or killing the boss starts the cooldown.
rewards: Loot including blueprints, Hyperium, armor catalysts
Voucher: 1 per run in 2025-2026 videos, but see warning
requirementsText: About 10+ DPS weapon and healing (video estimate)

cost.text: Ammo, decay and healing for one short run.
cost.markupNote: Players report Hyperium and catalysts selling well above TT in 2025. Treat this as volatile.

currencies.name: Hyperion Daily Voucher
currencies.note: Previously 1 per run; possibly removed in 19.12.0.

activities.limits: Vehicles blocked inside daily robot instances. Since VU 19.0.2 you cannot log back in inside a dungeon that is on cooldown; if you disconnect early you can rerun it.

cooldown.resetNote: Ripcraze lists 20 h. Officially the cooldown starts when the boss dies or when you leave voluntarily (VU 18.14.3).

score.rationale: Short, beginner-reachable boss with real loot upside.

warnings: One player wrote on 15 Nov 2026 that 19.12.0 'removed a voucher from the easiest robot instance'. This is unconfirmed, so check your loot.
The rare unlimited-weapon drop stories are anecdotes, not drop rates.

activities.title: Robot instances: Elevex (Defenatron), NEX-Comm (Broadcastus), Voltforge Prime (Oblivitron)
activities.summary: Three harder daily robot instances, reached through maintenance tunnels and ruined bases. Ripcraze rates Elevex and NEX-Comm medium and Voltforge Prime 'Brutal'. Bosses drop blueprints and items, and all three count toward 'The Ultimate Threat'.
steps: Learn the maintenance tunnel routes.
Run the instance. The same pattern applies: clear rooms, unlock gates at side computers, kill the boss.
Voltforge Prime has had an exit teleporter in the boss room since VU 19.0.2.
rewards: Progress toward The Ultimate Threat (30 vouchers once)
requirementsText: Mid to high level gear; one 2025 player at level 100 with 250+ HP could not solo Oblivitron

cost.text: Significant ammo and decay per run.

cooldown.resetNote: Ripcraze lists 20 h per instance; starts at boss death or voluntary exit.

score.rationale: Good loot and needed for The Ultimate Threat, but costly for weaker avatars.

warnings: Whether each boss also pays a voucher now is not confirmed after 19.12.0.

activities.title: Cave bosses: Verdathos, Terrorax, Cinderak, Vesuvor
activities.summary: Four creature-boss caves on a 20-hour timer. Ripcraze rates Verdathos and Terrorax medium, Cinderak hard and Vesuvor extreme. They feed the one-time missions 'Taming the Wilds' and 'Extinguishing the Flames'. Loot is collected automatically in Verdathos, Cinderak and Vesuvor.
steps: Start with Verdathos or Terrorax.
Enter Ashflow Cavern (Cinderak) from the north side.
Vesuvor is in Scorchrift Cavern in the south.
rewards: Progress toward Taming the Wilds and Extinguishing the Flames
requirementsText: Mid-level gear for medium caves; strong gear for Cinderak and Vesuvor

cost.text: Ammo, decay and healing.

locations.label: Ashflow Cavern (Cinderak), enter from the north

score.rationale: Mid-game boss loop with one-time voucher payoffs.

warnings: Cinderak and Vesuvor were disabled for a while in 2025 after a respawn exploit and re-enabled in VU 19.0.2.

activities.title: Taming the Wilds and Extinguishing the Flames
activities.summary: One-time missions from Ironhaven. Kill Verdathos and Terrorax ('Taming the Wilds'), which unlocks 'Extinguishing the Flames' (Cinderak and Vesuvor). Players list 10 vouchers for each.
steps: Take Taming the Wilds in Ironhaven.
Kill Verdathos and Terrorax in their caves.
Hand in, then take Extinguishing the Flames.
Kill Cinderak and Vesuvor.

cost.text: The cost of the four boss runs.

activities.limits: One-time. One player who abandoned it could not get it back.

score.rationale: Twenty vouchers on top of runs you might do anyway.

warnings: Do not abandon it; a player reported the mission did not come back (Oct 2025).

activities.title: The Ultimate Threat (all four robot bosses)
activities.summary: A one-time mission from the General: kill the bosses of all four robot instances, including Oblivitron. Players list it as the biggest one-time voucher reward, 30 vouchers.
steps: Take it in Ironhaven (General Tiberius Ashfall's line of missions).
Kill Droktimus Prime, Defenatron, Broadcastus and Oblivitron.
requirementsText: High-level gear for Oblivitron

cost.text: Four boss runs, Oblivitron being expensive.

score.rationale: Large voucher payout, gated by the hardest robot boss.

activities.title: Operation: Scrapheap (10 named robots)
activities.summary: A one-time hunt for ten rare named robots that appear in normal robot spawns, some only after many kills. You only need to damage a target before someone else kills it, so teaming up works. Reward: 10 vouchers.
steps: Find each named robot. Players posted the waypoints below.
Hit it at least once. Credit is given even if another player gets the kill.
Some spawn in cycles after many kills in their area, e.g. Coordinator Prime then Drone Relic then Drone Eternal. Coordinator Prime itself does not count.
requirementsText: Survive near high-level robots, or tag along with others

cost.text: Time camping spawns plus ammo.

score.rationale: Cheap if you tag kills, but camping rare spawns can take hours.

warnings: Spawn spots are player reports from 2025-2026 and can move.

activities.title: Tonathan AI missions
activities.summary: Tonathan gives AI-generated multi-target hunting missions. Ripcraze calls them 'Brutal'. Players report 1,000-5,000+ PED cycled for about 50 PED of universal ammo, some Blazar/Nova and a voucher. Newcomer guides say skip them.
steps: Talk to Tonathan in Ironhaven.
Before committing, scout each target. The timer is how long you have to finish, not when the next one is offered.
rewards: About 50 PED universal ammo (cap), Blazar or Nova, sometimes a pill or ring, plus 1 voucher (players and Ripcraze)
requirementsText: High DPS weapon and many hours

cost.text: Often thousands of PED cycled.

activities.limits: Time-limited; an unfinished mission is replaced when it runs out.

cooldown.resetNote: Ripcraze lists 24 h; a player video mentions 24 h to finish.

score.rationale: Poor return on time and cost for most players.

warnings: Requirements were reduced in VU 18.15.0, but players still called it too long in Oct 2025.

activities.title: Elara Vox: crashed Spina ships
activities.summary: Since VU 19.2.0 Elara Vox sends you into one of three crashed Spina ship instances, ordered by difficulty. Players report a short ARIS-only damage buff for finishing (1/2/3% for 1 hour), and the cave boss drops Rakamakafon, needed for the chemistry chain.
steps: Take the mission from Elara Vox and pick a ship. Players report juvenile-novice creatures in ship 1, adult-hardened in ship 2, and up to ascendant in ship 3.
Use the door codes players posted (first door 2662437, second door 1) to reach the boss cave.
Kill the Spina boss and return to Elara.
rewards: Geomagnetic damage buff on ARIS, 1/2/3% for 1 h (players)

cost.text: Ammo and decay for the chosen ship.

score.rationale: Useful buff and a chemistry ingredient. The difficulty can be chosen.

warnings: The Spina boss buff was too strong until a fix in VU 19.3.0, and the boss stats were lowered in VU 19.8.0. Buff numbers are a Dec 2025 player report.

activities.title: Chemistry chain: B.O.O.T.S. translator, Pharmatron and Cryo Lab
activities.summary: Two chemists near Alfonso speak gibberish. Nora asks for a translator (B.O.O.T.S.), then the chemists send you to find three parts. That unlocks the Pharmatron (skill-gain infusions) and the Cryo Lab daily, which pays blank blueprints and a lifesteal buff. VU 19.7.0 added Personal Pharmatron blueprints.
steps: Teleport to Alfonso and find the two chemists on the beach to the north.
Talk to Nora and hand in 5 Rakamakafon, 50 Derelict Robot Component, 2 CushionCore Padding and 2 Durable Laser Optics for B.O.O.T.S.
Return to the chemists and find three parts: in the Cryo Lab (last room, bottom floor), at the 'Sight angle' spot, and near the swamp by the Furor lab.
Hand in to unlock the Pharmatron and the Cryo Lab daily.
rewards: Access to the Pharmatron and chemistry crafting
Cryo Lab daily: 5/10/15 blank blueprints at levels 2/3/4 plus a 3% lifesteal buff for 1 h (players)
requirementsText: Rakamakafon from the Spina ship bosses
Two voucher blueprints' worth of components

cost.text: Materials listed in the steps plus boss runs.

activities.limits: The unlock is one-time. The Cryo Lab daily repeats, but its cooldown was not found.

locations.label: Chemists on the beach north of Alfonso

score.rationale: Opens a crafting niche and a daily, but needs several earlier steps and materials.

warnings: Based on one detailed player post from Dec 2025. Material counts and rewards are not in the official notes.
The player post claims the skill-gain infusions are very strong. That is unverified.

activities.title: Hyperion armor (the long-term voucher goal)
activities.summary: Vouchers buy base Hyperion armor pieces at the Ironhaven voucher terminal: 80 vouchers plus CushionCore Padding and FlexPlate Fabric per piece. To upgrade a tier, merge two pieces of the same tier with 10 catalysts of the next tier, from Base up to Perfected. Set bonuses start at Improved. Since VU 19.0.2 any mix of 7 pieces gives the bonus of the lowest tier worn.
steps: Save 80 vouchers and craft the padding and fabric for the piece you want (e.g. helmet 104 + 104; harness 192 + 192).
Buy the base piece at the voucher terminal. Stock is limited and restocks; it was restocked in VU 19.12.0.
Upgrade at the upgrade station: 2 pieces of a tier + 10 next-tier Hyperion Armor Catalysts. Excess value returns as Nanocubes.
Alternatively, buy pieces or catalysts from players.
rewards: Hyperion armor; Perfected 7-piece set listed at +15 HP, 7.5% less incoming damage, 1.5% more outgoing damage (May 2025 table)
requirementsText: 80 vouchers per base piece
CushionCore Padding and FlexPlate Fabric per piece: helmet 104, harness 192, arm guards 120, gloves 72, thigh 112, shin 112, foot 88

cost.text: Vouchers plus crafted materials. Players often sell 'pulls' (using their vouchers for a buyer who supplies the materials) for about 150-250 PED, a price that fell during 2025-2026.
cost.markupNote: Upgraded pieces and higher catalysts trade at large and volatile markups. Prices are player reports only.

currencies.name: Hyperion Daily Voucher
currencies.note: 80 per base piece; consumed on purchase.

activities.limits: Vendor stock is capped on purpose and restocks over time. One Perfected piece needs 32 base pieces worth of vouchers (2,560).

score.rationale: Top long-term reward on ARIS, and the reason vouchers hold value. Full sets take years solo.

warnings: Stats and costs come from a May 2025 player table. Re-check in game.
A Sept 2025 note refunded a hidden PED cost on Hyperion Foot Guards (M).

activities.title: ARIS Codex progress
activities.summary: ARIS creatures have Codex entries, balanced to the same formula as the rest of the universe (VU 18.14.2), so steady hunting pays skill rewards. ARIS challenges such as Necroid feed the Attribute meta challenge. Since VU 19.10.0, tracking slots are counted per territory. VU 19.12.1 added the new southern challenges to the meta retroactively.
steps: Open the Codex and track ARIS creatures you hunt anyway.
Claim rank rewards as they fill.
Hover the claim button to see the skill reward size before choosing.

cost.text: Comes from normal hunting spend.

score.rationale: Free extra value on top of hunting you already do.

warnings: Players reported new southern creatures not counting toward the meta until the 17 Nov 2026 fix.

activities.title: Vault S-9 wave event (S9-WARDEN)
activities.summary: An open-world wave event in the far south-west that ends with the S9-WARDEN boss, which players compare to a sandking wave. The surrounding robots become shared during the event. Killing the Warden gives damage buffs (multipliers fixed in VU 19.8.0).
steps: Watch for the event at Vault S-9.
Join other players; mobs are shared during the event.
Stay for the Warden.
requirementsText: Mid-level or better gear

cost.text: Ammo and decay.

activities.limits: Players say buff contribution thresholds are high.

score.rationale: A social event that is easy to join when it runs.

warnings: Do not confuse it with the co-op Vault S-9 instance added in VU 19.12.0.

activities.title: Co-op Vaults S-3, S-6 and S-9
activities.summary: Three cooperative challenges activated in VU 19.12.0, each with its own difficulty. At least two players are required. Entering uses Access Fragments. Emergency Exit terminals near revive points let a stuck player leave, but used fragments are not refunded (VU 19.12.1).
steps: Team up (2+ players).
Gather Access Fragments.
Enter at the vault entrance and clear it together.
rewards: Boss loot incl. Hyperion Aurora amplifier blueprints (players)
requirementsText: At least 2 players
Access Fragments (source not documented)

cost.text: Access Fragments plus ammo and decay.

currencies.name: Access Fragment
currencies.note: Consumed per run; not returned if you leave via an emergency exit.

score.rationale: New endgame team content, but costs and fragment sources are still unclear.

warnings: Official (VU 19.12.1): if you leave through an Emergency Exit terminal, the Access Fragments already used for that run are NOT returned.
Official (VU 19.12.0): at least two players are required to complete a vault.
Two weeks old. Several bugs (doors locking, blueprints not rendering) were reported and partly fixed on 17 Nov 2026.
How to obtain Access Fragments was not found in any source.

activities.title: Reach Breakwater on the southern continent
activities.summary: VU 19.12.0 opened the southern continent. Hyperion's outpost there is Breakwater. The official notes say to travel with Nora Gretz or find your own way. Players report Nora's route as a short chain: kill robots, then hand in materials (one estimate: about 150 PED). Players who tried driving by boat hit an invisible wall.
steps: Find Nora Gretz by the water near Ironhaven (players describe the harbor area / Hyperium vendor).
Do her task chain (robot kills, then materials).
Travel with Nora. Since VU 19.12.1 you arrive on solid ground.
Register the Breakwater Landing teleporter, then Stillwater and Farpoint as you explore.
rewards: Access to Breakwater, its weekly contract, Qay Sekku missions, south instances and scientists
requirementsText: Materials for Nora's chain

cost.text: One player estimated about 150 PED in materials (14 Nov 2026). Not confirmed.

score.rationale: Opens all new Nov 2026 content. The entry cost is uncertain.

warnings: Official (VU 19.12.0): you can travel with Nora Gretz or find your own way there. No working independent route was documented by players as of 14 Nov 2026.
Very new (11 Nov 2026). One player asked whether a 'Frontier Pass' is needed; that is unconfirmed.
Players reported respawning far from the action in the south (Lastlight revive was reported broken). Bring extra healing.

activities.title: The Sketh Incursion (Sgt. JESTER) and Withering Mist protection
activities.summary: In Breakwater, Sgt. JESTER starts 'The Sketh Incursion'. Its follow-ups lead to Dr. Hans Ramoray and protection against the Withering Mist, which you need to enter the Sketh area. The official notes mention two southern story missions, 'ARIS - The Incursion Resurgent' and 'ARIS - A Fresh Breath', which can now be progressed at the same time.
steps: Talk to Sgt. JESTER at the Breakwater starting area.
Complete The Sketh Incursion and its follow-ups.
See Dr. Hans Ramoray for mist protection before entering the Sketh area.
rewards: Access to the Sketh area and its sites

cost.text: Unknown.

activities.limits: Players report mist protection can be lost.

score.rationale: Gateway to southern content, details still thin.

warnings: The chain order comes from a forum reply (19 Nov 2026). The two story mission names come from the official notes, but their content was not documented.

activities.title: Breakwater Field Contract (Juston Sureul, weekly)
activities.summary: The second weekly hunting contract added in VU 19.12.0. Same model as Jimothy's: choose difficulty, get a target. Ripcraze lists 3, 7 or 11 vouchers.
steps: Talk to Juston Sureul in Breakwater.
Pick a difficulty and hunt the target.
Hand in.

cost.text: Ammo and decay.

score.rationale: Second weekly voucher source once Breakwater is open.

warnings: Rewards were corrected on 17 Nov 2026 and may differ from the tracker.

activities.title: Qay Sekku missions (Breakwater)
activities.summary: Four repeatable missions from Qay Sekku: Field Repairs and Mutation Samples (24 h), Machine Intelligence and Unstable Minds (168 h). Ripcraze lists 10 PED of universal ammo plus 1-3 PED of skills each. One player mentions gathering items before Qay's missions open.
steps: Talk to Qay Sekku next to Juston in Breakwater.
Do whichever missions are available.
Hand in for ammo and skills.
rewards: 10 PED universal ammo + 1 PED skill (Field Repairs, Mutation Samples)
10 PED universal ammo + 2-3 PED skill (Machine Intelligence)
10 PED universal ammo + 1-3 PED skill (Unstable Minds)

cost.text: Unknown per mission.
cost.markupNote: Rewards are TT ammo and skills.

cooldown.resetNote: Ripcraze: Field Repairs and Mutation Samples 24 h; Machine Intelligence and Unstable Minds 168 h.

score.rationale: Ammo plus skill rewards with short timers.

warnings: Only the Ripcraze tracker documents these. Two of the four are weekly; the app timer here uses 24 h.

activities.title: Southern instances: Vanguard's Approach, Gatekeeper's Abode, Choraxis
activities.summary: New 20-hour instances in the south. Ripcraze rates Vaelxar (The Vanguard's Approach) easy, Xarneth (behind a sealed entrance) medium and Choraxis hard. Ripcraze lists 1 voucher each. A player's two Vanguard runs gave 1 voucher plus Hyperium, ore or a blueprint.
steps: Start with The Vanguard's Approach (boss Vaelxar, reported level 30).
Choraxis' entrance sits under tough ranged creatures. Go with help.
rewards: Loot such as Hyperium, ores, blueprints

cost.text: Ammo and decay.

score.rationale: Extra daily vouchers once you are in the south.

warnings: Choraxis has no waypoint in Ripcraze yet.

activities.title: Missing Scientists: Southern Expedition
activities.summary: A southern version of the scientist hunt. Ripcraze says the quest starts at Enrico Pallazzo. Players had found 14 of an apparent 15 by 18 Nov 2026. The reward was not reported.
steps: Visit each scientist and interact.
Several sit in the Withering Mist; get protection first.

cost.text: Travel only.

locations.label: Enrico Pallazzo (quest start; out in the open above the water)

score.rationale: Cheap exploration. The reward is unknown and one scientist is still unfound.

warnings: The 15th scientist had not been found by 18 Nov 2026.
John Ingoff's height (1021) suggests a high perch; follow the waypoint's height.

activities.title: A Signal Beyond the Mist: unlock Misty Island
activities.summary: A short exploration mission in the far south. It unlocks permanent passage to Misty Island, a Land Area that the society Hardcore won in the first ARIS land grab on 14 Nov 2026. Its Veilback creature (Young: level 13, 6,000 HP) has a large Codex reward; the owner lists 9.34 PED of skills at rank 1.
steps: Interact with the Ancient Transit Device to start 'ARIS - A Signal Beyond the Mist'.
Visit the first signal relic and choose 'Remember the Echo'.
Visit the second relic and choose 'Remember the Pattern'.
Return to the device and choose 'Activate the Passage'.
rewards: Access to Veilback hunting and its Codex

cost.text: Travel only.

activities.limits: Misty Island is a player-owned Land Area. The owner reported a 1% hunting tax in Nov 2026. Land grabs: 45 min to disable the fort, then the marker must be held 30 min; a defended island locks for 14 days.

score.rationale: Free, quick unlock. The Veilback Codex is expensive to finish but rewarding per rank.

warnings: The guide is written by the Land Area owner. Its Codex figure is the owner's; players estimated the full Codex at about 1.5 million PED cycle.

activities.title: Dr. Vera Santis: Psionic Warfare Division and the Lure chip
activities.summary: VU 19.7.0 brought Hyperion's 'Applied Mindforce and Psionic Warfare Division' under Dr. Vera Santis to Ironhaven. It came with missions (one is 'Psionic Impressions') and the 'Lure', a new Mindforce support chip that started as ARIS-only.
steps: Talk to Dr. Vera Santis in Ironhaven.
Psionic Impressions may need several kills to capture the discharge (VU 19.8.0).

cost.text: Unknown.

score.rationale: Interesting for Mindforce users. Little documented detail.

warnings: Only the release notes describe this. No firsthand guide was found.

activities.title: The Altar (rebuilt May 2026)
activities.summary: A mysterious Altar on a separate island south-west of the main volcano. It was postponed in July 2025, pulled for a rebuild in Dec 2025, and activated rebuilt on 13 May 2026. It has an 'altar boss' (VU 19.8.1). The island has a single intended route.
steps: Find the intended route to the Altar island; it is in a separate server area since VU 18.15.0.
Prepare for the altar boss.

cost.text: Unknown. Players in 2025 said it asked for a very large amount of Hyperium; that was before the rebuild.

score.rationale: Secret content with almost no public detail.

warnings: No current firsthand guide found. Treat this as a pointer only.
